article.story: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. -- — Deuce Jones scored 18 points as UAB beat Florida International 94-82 on Tuesday. Jones also had six assists for the Blazers (3-2). Aleks Alston scored 15 points while shooting 6 for 9, including 2 for 4 from beyond the arc, and added 11 rebounds. Elijah Duval went 6 of 9 from the field to finish with 15 points. Tijan Saine led the Panthers (3-1) in scoring, finishing with 23 points. Florida International also got 21 points from Trey Beamer. Corey Caulker had 12 points. UAB got a team-high 12 points across the first half from Justyn Fernandez, but it was only enough to head to the locker room tied, 40-40. UAB took the lead for good with 19:04 remaining in the second half, with Duval scoring 15 second-half points. Up next UAB plays George Washington on Friday, and Florida International hosts Long Beach State on Monday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
